buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address AIG(Communication) Communication Store No. 1 Safdarjung Lane New Delhi - 110011 . . 3. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Director of Accounts, CABINET SECRETARIAT SPL WING(SPG) payable at NEW DELHI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of Director of Accounts, CABINET SECRETARIAT SPL WING(SPG) payable at New Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Payment will be made 100% against delivery of stores in full, good and satisf actory condition, after meeting all terms and conditions given in Tender Enquiry as well as AT/Supply Order. 2. Warranty: Warranty of all stores will be 03 years from the date of technical a cceptance by SPG. Total replacement during warranty period is required against any types of manufacturing and workmanship defects. During the term of warra nty the time to attend the complaints will be as under:- Response Time 01 day Rectification Time 02 days for minor faults 15 days for major faults In case of major defect requiring defective equipment to be taken to the s upplier workshop for more than 15 days then supplier will provide substitute of defective equipment to SPG. Further, supplier will have to complete the rectifica tion of defective equipment within 30 days time limit otherwise a penalty 0.5% of unit price of the product may be charged as penalty for each week of delay a s mentioned in GeM Contract. 3. Technical Evaluation:

3.1 SPG shall conduct a technical evaluation of the items offered by the bidders as part of the bidding process. The technical evaluation of the items quoted by t he bidder shall be conducted on any convenient date within fifteen (15) days fro m the date of bid opening. The exact date, time, venue and trial directives for t he technical evaluation will be communicated to the bidders in due course. 3.2 The technical evaluation shall be carried out to verify compliance with the T echnical Specifications required by SPG as per the trial directives of SPG. The items quoted by the Bidder in the bid shall be ready and bidder will be required to physically produce them along with necessary documents & certificates on th e scheduled date of technical evaluation. 3.3 A one-time additional opportunity of up to seven (7) days may be granted at the discretion of the SPG to present the items physically for evaluation. No furth er opportunity shall be provided beyond this extended period. Failure to present the items within the stipulated timeline shall result in disqualification from the t echnical evaluation process. 3.4 The offered Product with complete features and required licenses for all feat ures as asked will be tested by SPG after installing them in the existing Setup of SPG comprising of SonicWall TZ 670 & TZ 270 for testing its full compatibility wi thin the existing Setup and for testing compliance of all technical specification a s asked by SPG. Only those bids which are found to be technically compliant sha ll be considered for further financial evaluation. 3.5 The decision of the department regarding the technical evaluation shall be fi nal and binding on all bidders. 4. Fall Clause: The bidder should submit an undertaking (as part of Fall Clause ) that they have not and will not sell the same material/equipment at prices low er than the contract price, during the currency of this contract till delivery of co mplete store as per contract. In case, it supplies or quotes a lower rate to other Government, Public Se ctors or Private Organizations, it would charge the lower rate to SPG also & pay ment shall be released/adjusted accordingly. 5. Custom Clearance: The clearance of imported licenses shall be done by th e supplier. 6. The CDEC (Custom Duty Exemption Certificate) for imported items will be at the discretion of SPG, if applicable, as per rule. 7. Contract termination/ splitting/ rejection clause: SPG reserves the righ t to increase or decrease the bill of quantity, accept or reject the quotation, alte r any or all of the terms and conditions of tender, split orders, terminate or canc el the contract at any time without assigning the reason. The decision of SPG in this regard shall be final and binding to both the parties. 8. Technical support 24x7: The firm shall ensure technical support both telep honically as well as physically through local experts within New Delhi in case for faults, failures and any type of technical encounters. 9. Exchange Rate Variation (ERV): ERV shall not be applicable for this tende r. 10. Others: 10.1 The Buyer reserves the right to amend, withdraw or cancel the bid or contr

act in part or full, at any stage, in accordance with applicable procurement rule s and GeM guidelines. The decision of the buyer in this regard shall be final and binding. The bidder, by participating in this tender, expressly agrees to this con dition. 10.2 If any stage it is discovered that the seller has made any false declaration, misrepresented facts or suppressed material information in the bid, the buyer r eserves the right to cancel the contract, forfeit any payments or securities and t ake further action as per the provision of GeM/GFR. Such action may be taken e ven after award of contract or during execution. 10.3 The buyer reserves the right to assess the final suitability of the goods sup plied. In cases where the seller offers a higher or improved version of the item meeting or exceeding the specified technical parameters the buyer may at its discretion, accept such upgraded goods at the same price, terms and conditions provided it does not compromise any critical functional requirements and is in t he interest of the project. 10.4 In case of any ambiguity, the provisions of General Financial Rule-2017 an d manual for procurement of Goods-2024 with the latest applicable amendment s shall prevail. 10.5 Representations:-As per latest functionality/updation of GeM portal, rep resentation against bid, if any, will be acceptable within prescribed time limit th rough GeM only. No manual representation will be entertained. .
